fields.description: Disclosed ratio of current and savings account deposits to total deposits.
fields.hint: Use the key ratios / management discussion / deposit profile disclosure. Unit is percent. Prefer a directly disclosed ratio; calculate outside extraction only if current/savings and total deposits are reliable.

fields.name_ru: Обязательные резервы на счетах в центральных банках
fields.name_en: Cash and balances with central bank
aliases_ru: Обязательные резервы на счетах в ЦБ РФ
Обязательные резервы на счетах в Центральном банке
aliases_en: cash and balances with Reserve Bank of India
cash and balances with central bank
fields.description: Cash in hand and balances maintained with the central bank.
fields.hint: For Indian banks, use Schedule 6 'Cash and Balances with Reserve Bank of India'. Take the total schedule amount unless a narrower line is explicitly requested.

aliases_ru: Денежные средства и эквиваленты денежных средств
Денежные средства и их эквиваленты на конец периода
aliases_en: cash and cash equivalents at end of year
Cash and cash equivalents at end of period
fields.description: Cash, current accounts and short-term highly liquid balances presented as cash and cash equivalents.
fields.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement closing line if cash and cash equivalents are disclosed there. In Indian bank statements, also check Schedule 6 and Schedule 7, but do not confuse statutory cash/balances schedules with a broader cash-equivalent definition if the cash flow statement gives a narrower total.

fields.description: Disclosed Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio.
fields.hint: Use the Basel III / capital adequacy disclosure. Unit is percent. Do not use absolute CET1 capital.

fields.name_en: Changes in operating assets and liabilities
aliases_ru: Изменения в операционных активах и обязательствах
aliases_en: changes in operating assets and liabilities
adjustments for operating assets and liabilities
fields.description: Net cash-flow effect of changes in operating assets and liabilities.
fields.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement subtotal if explicitly disclosed. If no subtotal is printed, derive only from adjacent cash flow subtotals; do not blindly sum all asset and liability movements across the statement.

fields.description: Total deposits accepted by the bank from customers and other depositors.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 3 'Deposits'. Take the total deposits line, not one component such as demand deposits, savings deposits or term deposits.

fields.name_ru: Комиссии, обменные операции и брокерские доходы
fields.description: Income from commission, exchange and brokerage as a component of other income.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 14 'Other Income' and the line 'Commission, Exchange and Brokerage'. Do not use the full Other Income total.

fields.description: Absolute amount of Common Equity Tier 1 capital used for Basel/RBI capital adequacy purposes.
fields.hint: Use the Basel III / Pillar 3 / capital adequacy disclosure. Take the absolute CET1 capital amount, not the CET1 ratio percentage.

aliases_en: claims against the bank not acknowledged as debts
fields.description: Total off-balance sheet contingent liabilities disclosed by the bank.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 12 'Contingent Liabilities'. Take the total schedule amount, not a single component such as guarantees or forward exchange contracts.

fields.description: Loans or advances to corporate / commercial borrowers.
fields.hint: Use loan/advance portfolio segmentation notes. Do not use total advances, retail advances, or priority sector advances unless the table explicitly identifies a corporate/wholesale borrower segment.

fields.description: Bank-reported ratio of operating expenses to operating income for the period.
fields.hint: Extract only directly reported actual CIR. Do not calculate it from income and expenses or use a target or forecast ratio.

aliases_en: capital to risk weighted assets ratio
fields.description: Disclosed total regulatory capital ratio to risk-weighted assets.
fields.hint: Use the capital adequacy / Basel III disclosure. Unit is percent. Do not confuse with CET1 ratio or Tier 1 ratio.

fields.description: Debt instruments issued by the bank and outstanding at the reporting date.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 4 'Borrowings' or debt instruments notes. Include bonds, notes, debentures and certificates of deposit where they represent issued debt. Do not use investment securities held as assets.

aliases_ru: Активы по отложенному налогу на прибыль
fields.description: Income tax asset arising from deductible temporary differences and carried forward tax items.
fields.hint: Use the tax note or the balance sheet line if separately presented. Do not net with deferred tax liabilities unless the report presents only a net deferred tax asset.

aliases_ru: Обязательства по отложенному налогу на прибыль
fields.description: Income tax liability arising from taxable temporary differences.
fields.hint: Use the tax note or the balance sheet line if separately presented. Do not net with deferred tax assets unless the report presents only a net deferred tax liability.

fields.description: Deposits repayable on demand.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 3 'Deposits' and take the demand deposits total. Do not include savings or term deposits unless the report aggregates them explicitly.

fields.description: Fair value liability arising from derivative financial instruments.
fields.hint: Use financial instrument / derivative notes or balance sheet disclosures. Do not use notional amounts or contingent liability amounts for outstanding forward exchange contracts.

fields.description: Dividend amount disclosed as paid, proposed or appropriated for the period.
fields.hint: Use the appropriations section of the Profit and Loss Account, statement of changes in equity or cash flow statement, depending on the report wording. Do not confuse dividend per share with total dividend amount.

fields.description: Dividends received or dividend income recognised during the period.
fields.hint: Use the Cash Flow Statement if the report explicitly presents dividends received. If only statutory P&L is available, use Schedule 13/14 investment income only when it is clearly identified as dividend income.

fields.description: Profit before income tax for the reporting period.
fields.hint: Use the Profit and Loss Account line immediately before tax expense. Preserve losses as negative values.

fields.description: Basic earnings per ordinary equity share for the reporting period.
fields.hint: Use the Profit and Loss Account or EPS note. Prefer basic EPS over diluted EPS. Unit should be currency per share, not the report scaling used for balance sheet figures.

fields.name_ru: Капитал, приходящийся на акционеров материнской компании
fields.name_en: Equity attributable to owners of the parent
aliases_en: Equity attributable to equity holders of the parent
Total shareholders' equity attributable to the parent
Equity attributable to owners of the Company
fields.description: Собственный капитал за вычетом неконтролирующих долей — часть капитала, принадлежащая акционерам материнской компании.
fields.hint: Баланс, раздел КАПИТАЛ: «Итого капитал, приходящийся на акционеров материнской компании» — строка ДО «Неконтролирующие доли». НЕ путать с итогом капитала (тот включает неконтролирующие доли). Нет отдельной строки — значит неконтролирующих долей нет, бери итог капитала.

aliases_en: borrowings from Reserve Bank of India
fields.description: Funding borrowed from the central bank.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 4 'Borrowings' and the component from Reserve Bank of India / central bank. Do not confuse with balances maintained with RBI on the asset side.

fields.description: Goodwill arising on acquisition or consolidation.
fields.hint: Use the balance sheet or business combination / consolidation note. Do not include other intangible assets if goodwill is disclosed separately.

fields.description: Investments in government securities held by the bank.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 8 'Investments' and the government securities line. Do not use the full investments total or securities pledged under repo.

fields.description: Gross balance of non-performing assets or non-performing advances before provisions.
fields.hint: Use the asset quality / NPA disclosure. Do not substitute Stage 3 loans unless the report explicitly reconciles Stage 3 to NPA; Indian GAAP/RBI NPA classification is the native source.

fields.description: Disclosed ratio of gross NPAs to gross advances or equivalent denominator.
fields.hint: Use the disclosed asset-quality ratio. Unit is percent. Do not return the absolute gross NPA amount.

fields.name_ru: Расход по текущему налогу на прибыль
fields.description: Income tax expense for the reporting period.
fields.hint: Use the Profit and Loss Account or tax note. Prefer the tax expense charged to profit for the period; if the report separates current and deferred tax, do not substitute one component for the total tax expense unless the enum is explicitly requested as current tax.

fields.description: Gross or carrying amount of loans to individual / retail borrowers, depending on the report's segmentation basis.
fields.hint: Use loan/advance portfolio segmentation notes. In Indian reports, this may appear as retail advances. Do not use total advances or priority sector advances. Prefer gross exposure if the segmentation table is on a gross basis; otherwise preserve the disclosed basis.

fields.description: Carrying amount of identifiable non-physical assets, excluding goodwill when goodwill is separately disclosed.
fields.hint: Use the intangible assets note or the relevant line within fixed assets / other assets. Exclude goodwill, tangible fixed assets and right-of-use assets if separately disclosed.

fields.name_en: Balances with banks and money at call
aliases_en: balances with banks and money at call and short notice
fields.description: Amounts placed with other banks or available as money at call and short notice.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 7 'Balances with banks and money at call and short notice'. Take the relevant asset balance; do not use borrowings from other banks.

fields.description: Amounts borrowed from other banks or interbank counterparties.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 4 'Borrowings' and the component from other banks or interbank borrowings. Do not use deposits or balances placed with banks on the asset side.

fields.description: Total interest income earned by the bank during the period.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 13 'Interest Earned'. Take the total schedule amount, not one component such as interest on advances or income on investments.

fields.description: Total interest expense incurred by the bank during the period.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 15 'Interest Expended'. Take the total schedule amount, not one component such as interest on deposits or borrowings.

fields.description: Subordinated borrowings with lower repayment priority, often eligible for regulatory capital.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 4 'Borrowings', capital instruments notes, or Basel III capital disclosures. Do not include senior bonds or ordinary deposits.

fields.description: Disclosed liquidity coverage ratio.
fields.hint: Use the liquidity coverage / Basel III liquidity disclosure. Unit is percent. Prefer the disclosed average or period-end LCR according to the table label; do not use HQLA or net cash outflows for this enum.

fields.description: Text flag indicating whether the auditor issued a modified opinion for the current reporting period.
fields.hint: Use the Independent Auditor's Report. Return 0 for an unmodified opinion and 1 for a qualified, adverse, or disclaimer opinion. Do not create comparative periods unless a separate auditor's opinion is disclosed for them.

fields.description: Profit after tax for the reporting period before appropriation.
fields.hint: Use the Profit and Loss Account line after tax and before appropriations/transfers. In interim statements, preserve the exact period columns disclosed. Losses should retain the source sign.

fields.name_ru: Прибыль, приходящаяся на акционеров материнской компании
fields.name_en: Profit attributable to owners of the parent
aliases_en: Profit attributable to equity holders of the parent
Net income attributable to shareholders of the parent
Profit for the year attributable to owners of the Company
Net income attributable to controlling interest
fields.description: Часть чистой прибыли за период, приходящаяся на акционеров материнской компании, БЕЗ неконтролирующих долей.
fields.hint: ОПУ, блок распределения прибыли в самом низу: «Прибыль, приходящаяся на: акционеров материнской компании / неконтролирующие доли» — бери ПЕРВУЮ строку. Если распределения нет (у группы нет дочерних с неконтролирующей долей), прибыль совпадает с чистой прибылью — бери её.

fields.description: Interest earned minus interest expended for the period.
fields.hint: Indian statutory P&L normally gives Schedule 13 'Interest Earned' and Schedule 15 'Interest Expended'. Use a disclosed net interest income subtotal if present; otherwise it can be calculated from those two native lines outside extraction.

fields.description: Carrying amount of investments after provision for depreciation / impairment where disclosed.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 8 'Investments'. Prefer the net investments figure after provision for depreciation. Do not use gross investments if a net figure is separately disclosed.

fields.description: Non-performing assets after deducting related provisions according to the bank's disclosed NPA framework.
fields.hint: Use the asset quality / NPA disclosure. Do not calculate from gross NPA and provisions unless the disclosed table clearly provides the required components and no direct net NPA line is available.

fields.description: Disclosed ratio of net NPAs to net advances or equivalent denominator.
fields.hint: Use the disclosed asset-quality ratio. Unit is percent. Do not return the absolute net NPA amount.

fields.description: Equity attributable to shareholders other than the parent company in consolidated statements.
fields.hint: Use the consolidated balance sheet equity section. This item may be absent in standalone bank statements; return null when not separately disclosed.

aliases_en: payments to and provisions for employees
fields.description: Total operating expenses of the bank, including employee costs and other operating expenses.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 16 'Operating Expenses' or the Profit and Loss Account total for operating expenses. Preserve expense sign if the source presents expenses as negative amounts.

fields.description: Profit before provisions and contingencies, usually after interest and operating expenses.
fields.hint: Use the Profit and Loss Account subtotal before 'Provisions and Contingencies'. Do not use operating income/revenue; this is a profit subtotal after operating expenses.

fields.description: Assets not classified into the main banking balance sheet schedules.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 11 'Other Assets'. Take the total schedule amount, not changes in other assets from the cash flow statement.

fields.description: Total non-interest income presented in the statutory banking profit and loss statement.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 14 'Other Income'. Take the total schedule amount. Do not use only commission, exchange, brokerage, profit on sale of investments, or miscellaneous income unless the total is absent and explicitly derivable.

fields.description: Liabilities and provisions not classified as deposits, borrowings or capital.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 5 'Other Liabilities and Provisions'. Take the total schedule amount unless a more specific enum is requested.

fields.description: Perpetual capital instruments, typically eligible as Additional Tier 1 capital or similar regulatory capital.
fields.hint: Use capital instruments, borrowings or Basel III capital notes. Do not include ordinary term bonds, Tier 2 bonds, share capital or reserves.

fields.description: Carrying amount of tangible fixed assets used by the bank.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 10 'Fixed Assets' or the fixed assets note. Take the net block / written-down value, not gross cost. Exclude intangible assets, goodwill and right-of-use assets if they are disclosed separately.

fields.description: Advances classified under the priority sector lending framework.
fields.hint: Use priority sector lending disclosures or Schedule 9 category disclosures where present. Do not include all retail advances unless explicitly classified as priority sector.

fields.name_ru: Прибыль или убыток от обменных операций
fields.name_en: Profit or loss on exchange transactions
fields.description: Net result from foreign exchange / exchange transactions disclosed in other income.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 14 'Other Income' or the FX trading note. Preserve the sign: profit is positive, loss is negative. Do not include broad trading income unless exchange transactions are separately identified.

fields.name_ru: Расходы на резервы и условные обязательства
fields.description: Total P&L charge for provisions and contingencies in the statutory banking profit and loss statement.
fields.hint: Use the Profit and Loss Account line 'Provisions and Contingencies'. It usually appears after operating profit and before profit before tax. Do not replace it with IFRS ECL change or a closing allowance balance.

fields.description: Disclosed coverage of NPAs by provisions.
fields.hint: Use the asset quality / NPA disclosure or key ratios table. Unit is percent. Do not confuse with capital adequacy or liquidity ratios.

aliases_en: provision for diminution in value of investments
fields.description: Closing provision balance against investments due to depreciation or diminution in value.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 8 'Investments' or the investment provision note. This is a closing balance, not the P&L charge for the period unless the source explicitly labels it as a movement/charge.

fields.description: Provision amount related to non-performing assets or non-performing advances.
fields.hint: Use the NPA disclosure, provisions note, or the relevant component within 'Provisions and contingencies'. Distinguish between a balance-sheet provision stock and a P&L charge if the table gives both; preserve the disclosed basis.

fields.name_ru: Ценные бумаги, заложенные по договорам репо
fields.description: Securities transferred or pledged as collateral under repo or similar arrangements.
fields.hint: Use repo, collateral or investment notes. Take only securities pledged/transferred under repo; do not use repo borrowing liabilities or the full investments portfolio.

aliases_en: balance in profit and loss account
surplus in profit and loss account
fields.description: Accumulated profits retained in equity after appropriations and distributions.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 2 'Reserves and Surplus', especially the balance in the Profit and Loss Account / surplus line. Do not use net profit for the current period.

fields.description: Total assets and exposures weighted for regulatory capital purposes.
fields.hint: Use the capital adequacy / Basel III disclosure. Take total RWA, not capital ratios or individual risk-type components unless total is absent and clearly derivable.

fields.description: Savings bank deposits accepted by the bank.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 3 'Deposits' and take the savings bank deposits line. Do not include demand/current deposits or term deposits.

fields.description: Paid-up nominal value of issued share capital.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 1 'Capital'. Do not use reserves, share premium or total equity.

fields.description: Premium received over the nominal value of issued shares.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 2 'Reserves and Surplus' and the securities premium / share premium line. Do not include share capital or retained earnings.

fields.description: Statutory reserve balance within reserves and surplus.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 2 'Reserves and Surplus'. Take the statutory reserve / reserve fund closing balance. Do not use the current-period transfer to statutory reserve unless the enum explicitly asks for a transfer flow.

fields.description: Deposits with contractual maturity or term.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 3 'Deposits' and take the term deposits total. Do not include demand or savings deposits.

fields.description: Absolute amount of Tier 1 regulatory capital.
fields.hint: Use the capital adequacy / Basel III disclosure. Take the absolute Tier 1 capital amount, not the Tier 1 ratio percentage.

fields.description: Disclosed Tier 1 capital adequacy ratio.
fields.hint: Use the Basel III / capital adequacy disclosure. Unit is percent. Do not confuse with CET1 ratio or total CRAR/CAR.

fields.description: Absolute amount of Tier 2 regulatory capital.
fields.hint: Use the capital adequacy / Basel III disclosure. Take the absolute Tier 2 capital amount, not the Tier 2 ratio or subordinated debt balance unless clearly equal.

fields.description: Total carrying amount of all assets at the reporting date.
fields.hint: Use the Balance Sheet total assets line. It should reconcile to the sum of asset schedules, including cash and balances, investments, advances, fixed assets and other assets.

fields.name_ru: Инвестиции в ассоциированные и совместные предприятия
fields.name_en: Investments in associates and joint ventures
aliases_ru: Вложения в ассоциированные и совместные предприятия
Инвестиции в компании по методу долевого участия
aliases_en: investments in subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures
Investments in associates and joint ventures
fields.description: Investments in associates, joint ventures or similar investees, as separately disclosed.
fields.hint: Use Schedule 8 'Investments' or the investments note. Take the separate line for subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates if disclosed. Do not include the full investments total.

fields.description: Total equity attributable to shareholders and, in consolidated statements, non-controlling interests where applicable.
fields.hint: Use the equity total in the Balance Sheet. For Indian bank statutory format, reconcile to Schedule 1 'Capital' plus Schedule 2 'Reserves and Surplus' and any consolidated non-controlling interest line.

fields.description: Gross amount of loans or advances to customers before provisions, allowances or impairment deductions.
fields.hint: Keep the metric conceptually tied to loans/credit exposure. For Indian GAAP, search asset-quality disclosures and Schedule 9 'Advances' notes for 'gross advances' or 'advances before provisions'. Do not use net advances, NPA balances, or provision balances. This enum is intended to remain reusable outside India, where the local wording may be gross loans rather than advances.

fields.description: Net carrying amount of loans or advances to customers after related provisions or allowances.
fields.hint: For Indian GAAP, use Balance Sheet Schedule 9 'Advances' and take the net advances amount after provisions. Treat 'advances' as the local statutory wording for customer loans. Do not use gross advances, NPA balances, or provision balances for this enum.
